category_title: Unmotivated rising first graders with significant letter-sound recognition deficits and high interest in specific machinery
minimal_context: Derek is working one-on-one with a tutor at the Literacy Corner to identify magnetic letters and read nonsense words.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at these magnetic letters. Can you tell me the name and sound of this one?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: That is an 'm'. It makes the 'mmm' sound.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay, now let's try to read this made-up word on the paper by putting the sounds together.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know those letters. I am unable to read.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best to sound it out. What color is the first magnetic letter?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know the color! Reading is never fun. I just want to talk about dump trucks and tractors.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's look at these magnetic letters. Can you tell me the name and sound of this one?

STUDENT: That is an 'm'. It makes the 'mmm' sound.

TUTOR: Okay, now let's try to read this made-up word on the paper by putting the sounds together.

STUDENT: I don't know those letters. I am unable to read.

TUTOR: Just try your best to sound it out. What color is the first magnetic letter?

STUDENT: I don't know the color! Reading is never fun. I just want to talk about dump trucks and tractors.

task.content: Identifying letter names and sounds, and performing the Nonsense Word Test (NWT)
task.learning_goal: To obtain a comprehensive picture of Derek's reading skill set

context.time_context: Daily instruction during word work activities

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When assessed on letter recognition, letter sounds, and word chunking
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Unable to recognize numerous letters or produce letter sounds; experienced difficulty with word chunking

behavior_patterns.condition: When faced with basic readiness skills like color recognition
